title: Project 3 · Catch a broken rename
prompt: TaskItem is supplied. A rename candidate takes a task and a new title, and should return a copy with that title and the same Id and Done. Write public static bool RenameCheck(Func<TaskItem, string, TaskItem> candidate). Return true for a correct candidate. Return false for a faulty one that resets Done to false, and for one that returns the task without changing its title.
hints: Which input task makes the Done bug visible?
Rename a task that is already done, and compare the whole result with the record you expect.
Call candidate(new TaskItem(4, "Pack", true), "Ship") and compare it with new TaskItem(4, "Ship", true).
checks: Practice.RenameCheck((task, title) => task with { Title = title }) == true
Practice.RenameCheck((task, title) => new TaskItem(task.Id, title, false)) == false
checkLabels: A correct rename must pass your check.
A rename that resets Done must fail your check.
A rename that leaves the title unchanged must fail your check.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Renames a task that is not done, so the reset cannot show.
Checks the Id and Done but never the new title.

feedback: For each faulty candidate, find an input where its result differs from the correct one. Your check needs that input and the exact expected record.
